events.title: Live again: round two with the Spell Death demo
events.summary: Back for round two. The first stream went better than I expected, so I am pushing my luck. Spell Death is a roguelike deckbuilder where the alphabet is your deck. Draw letters, spell words, hit demons. Longer words hit harder, and some letters are printed on paper that changes the rules. Come hang out, throw words at me in chat, and grab the free demo right here.

events.title: Live: the dev plays the Spell Death demo
events.summary: Going live on this page. I made Spell Death alone, and now I get to play it in front of people. Brave or stupid, we will find out. You draw letters, spell words, and the words hit demons. Longer words hit harder. Chat gets to suggest words, I get to fail at them. The demo is free, right here on the store page. Wishlist if you like what you see.

events.title: Update 0.9.0 — Spell in 7 more languages (Beta)
events.summary: New: spell in your own language (Beta) You can now spell in German, Spanish, French, Portuguese (Brazil), Polish, Russian and Turkish, not only English. Every letter deck, tier and Lexicon word is rebuilt for each language. How to switch: Settings → GAME → Spelling Language. On first launch the game asks once if you want to spell in your interface language. A run keeps the language it started with, so the change applies to your next run. events.title: Demo update: Daily Climb, eleven languages, and a lot of fixes
events.summary: Thank you to everyone who played the demo and wrote in. This covers the last few demo updates. New Daily Climb. One seeded run per day, the same for everyone. Same letters, same map, same demons. It has its own Steam leaderboard, so you can see how your vocabulary stacks up. Eleven languages. The game now plays in English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Russian, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), Polish and Turkish. Pick one in Settings.
